gita: FYI nightly scan produced 6 medium + 1 high. Compliance asked for an auditable auto-triage flow and to remove long-lived SA keys from runners. Quick proposal: GH App GH Action writes an immutable audit event, creates a signed evidence pointer (sha256) to encrypted bucket, then only if a human reviewer is assigned allow an ephemeral KMS proxy to issue a scoped decrypt token. auto-escalation should be staged (24h assign, 48h digest, immediate page only for P0/P1).

omar: +1. KMS proxy should require PR id + evidence pointer and return a short-lived token (ttl 5m). Log actor, pr, key_id, key_version, reason. Deny tokens for auto-page path.

riley: GH Action sketch: write audit POST -> call scanner -> create pointer -> if threshold then call escalation webhook. Action must run as GitHub App and record audit_id in PR comment.

sec-bot: [scan-run] nightly/5367890123: 6 medium, 1 high (auth-redirect). report: https://scans.internal/5367890123

oncall-sre: do NOT page on every finding. aggregate digest every 24h with list+severity+owner+runbook link. include revoke steps and verification commands like: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ME" https://audit.internal/events?pr=5367890123 | jq '.[0] | {id,actor,action,timestamp}'

gita: action items: 1) omar: design kms-proxy + policy (ETA Thu) 2) riley: GH Action + audit write + PR attestation (ETA Wed) 3) oncall-sre: digest format + runbook template (ETA Mon) 4) compliance: sample signed audit entry (ETA Tue). I'll open ISSUE-SEC-621 and link here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
